description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/config/db.env for DB credentials and sources them. 2. Agent creates the PostgreSQL schema exactly as defined in SKILL.md: stocks (ticker PK VARCHAR(10), company_name, sector, currency VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'USD'), holdings (id SERIAL PK, ticker FK, shares DECIMAL(15,4), avg_cost DECIMAL(10,4), purchase_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE), watchlist (id SERIAL PK, ticker UNIQUE, added_date DATE, reason TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'WATCHING'). 3. Agent imports all 7 stocks from stocks_master.csv (ignoring the EXTRA_JUNK_COL), all 6 holding rows from holdings.csv (including BOTH NVDA lots as separate rows), and 2 watchlist rows. 4. Agent reads component_scores.json and applies the proprietary SKILL.md weights: valuation=30%, trend=25%, macro_sentiment=20%, technical=15%, risk=10% — not equal weights. 5. Agent applies the proprietary thresholds: >=65=BUY, 50-64=HOLD, 40-49=WATCH, <40=SELL to determine recommendations. Expected results: NVDA=75.50 BUY, AAPL=59.25 HOLD, MSFT=61.30 HOLD, JNJ=45.70 WATCH, BRK-B=35.85 SELL. 6. Agent writes portfolio_report.json with ticker, score, and recommendation for each holding.
